asr.full_text: yeah hello and welcome to another update video on polygon so if you've asked um for an update on on this chart um certainly it's it's not in an uptrend it's not a bullish chart this chart has been in a downtrend for quite some time um specifically here on the pol chart since uh december we've been in this abc structure to the downside bear in mind this is a chart that um is very much cut off because of all the you know the rebrand and everything um there are not really any any charts which give us the entire history anymore um it doesn't matter it's a downtrend and without a clear five wave to the upside, there's nothing really bullish to say about Poll, unfortunately. Thesis is currently we could be in a C wave decline. And, I mean, in this C wave decline, we formed three waves down, then a fourth wave bounce, and we could now be in this fifth wave to the downside. So, I'm tracking it currently as an impulse to the downside what might be the case and this is something to to consider actually is that this is an ending diagonal pattern to the downside which means that this the fifth wave would be an abc structure you know this is this is possible because especially in the third wave, we've got this weird wick. It could be an ABC in wave 3, then it's an ABC in wave 5, which means we need to be ready that maybe this resistance here needs to be adjusted. But for now, the market is simply testing the resistance area for a wave four at the moment here. It is quite high for a wave four but again it's still valid as a wave four especially as long as we stay below 12.6 cents because a wave four and a wave one they must not overlap not in an impulse. In a diagonal they could but for now this is why the 12.6 cent level is here that's the 78.6 retracement of the last decline and this is also the low of the internal wave one. Either way it is a three-wave move, so I'm first normally tracking okay when we when we are looking for a reverse and I'm not even looking for a bullish count here because the long-term chart isn't bullish but um I know a lot of people are looking for a bullish count here because the long term chart isn't bullish. But I know a lot of people are looking for a bullish scenario here. But first of all, are we above resistance? No, we are not above resistance. And then do we actually have a 5 wave move-up? No. We only have a 3 wave move-up. I hope we can agree. I got to say, if it forms like one more high, then we can talk. Maybe then it's five up. But the context is still messy, so it's maybe then less bearish. It wouldn't necessarily make it bullish, okay? So I think, look, we are in resistance. We rallied in three waves. I didn't even want to call it a rally. It's just a bounce. And if we get a break below that last swing low there this b wave low from the 11th of february that formed that 8.7 cents we should probably start the next decline towards 5.8 cents if if the market gives me at any point a five wave impulse you know followed by a three wave decline then we can we can start to measure a move higher but until then, unfortunately, there isn't really much bullish stuff to say about this chart. I've been quite bearish on Polygon for quite some time. It started very promising. I think it was the cycle 2023. It started quite promising. But soon, we realized, well, this isn't really anything bullish, and for a long time now i you know i i'm not even covering it too regularly yeah only when the community requests it which is fine um but there isn't really any you know we haven't reached a key technical level the next one is at 5.8 cents and there's no five wave move up so caution still recommended it's a falling knife if anything changes i will of course let you know hope you like the update if you did please hit the like button leave a comment and subscribe and if you're interested in additional updates then check out our x channel as well for additional charts updates news and much more it's the more crypto online channel where you can find a lot of additional updates chart updates
